letter.heading: A little letter for you
paragraphs:
Happy 2nd Anniversary, Pakhii! ❤️🥹

Dekhte dekhte amdr 2 ta bochor par hoye gelo. Bhabtei obak lage, ekta manush kivabe dhire dhire jiboner eto ta important part hoye jay!

Amdr moddhe hoyto distance ache, shob shomoy dekha hoy na, shob shomoy pashe thaka hoy na. Kintu believe me, dure thekeo tmi amr kache onek special.

Amader onek shundor moment ache, onek hashi ache, kichu oviman ache, kichu jhograo ache. Kintu shob kichur poreo ami chai amader golpota evabei cholte thakuk.

Ami jani na future e amdr jonno ki opekkha korche, but ami chai protita notun bochore tmr hat ta dhore bolte pari — We made it another year! ❤️

Thank you for being a part of my life. Thank you for tolerating my craziness, my moods and everything.

I may not be perfect, but amar bhalobasha tomar jonno real.

I love you, my girl. Today, tomorrow and all the days ahead.

Happy 2 Years of Us! ❤️🫂
